strengths: Correctly identifies B-cell lineage from CD79A, CD79B, CD22, CD37, POU2AF1.
Explicitly rules out T/NK/myeloid and notes pancreatic contamination.
weaknesses: Top-1 label remains broad B cell despite evidence supporting naive refinement.
Rank-2 subtype labels unmapped and include under-supported activated/mature option.
Does not resolve the IGHE signal.

strengths: Top-1 B cell supported by canonical B-cell DEGs.
Rank-2 naive B cell (CL:0000788) is supported by TCL1A, FCER2 and IGHM.
weaknesses: Top-1 label is less specific than the supported naive B-cell branch.
Naive subtype score is lower and pancreatic contamination/IGHE not explicitly resolved.

strengths: Correctly places the cluster in the B-cell lineage and excludes T/NK.
weaknesses: No direct memory markers (CD27/AICDA) in the marker list.
TCL1A is naive-associated, and SGO2 is not a memory-specific marker.
IGHM/IGHE do not provide positive support for memory B-cell identity.

supporting: B-cell identity: CD79A, CD79B, CD22, CD37, POU2AF1, STAP1, IGHM, IGKJ5/IGHJ6.
Naive B-cell refinement: TCL1A and FCER2 (CD23) with unswitched IGHM directly support the added naive component.
Enrichment terms B cell receptor signaling pathway and immunoglobulin complex corroborate B-lineage.
conflicting: TCL1A is a naive-associated marker, so the enrich memory-B-cell interpretation is not supported.
Pancreatic epithelial/ambient markers GATA4, KRT4, PIGR, CPA5, COL19A1 and the Reactome pancreatic ductal lineage term suggest contamination.
IGHE is inconsistent with a pure naive IgM+ population and is recorded as a minor secondary signal.
enrichment_or_literature: PMID 39560475 allowed as B-cell context citation.

provenance.note: Publication-facing final decision, evidence, QC disposition and evaluation fields are synchronized to the submitted Supplementary Data.
